annotationScope: Independent semantic gold labels for candidate name, email, explicit positively asserted canonical skills, and required/preferred skill evidence. Contradicted candidate skills are withheld from positive extraction and marked uncertain for matching; denial-only or non-candidate evidence is missing. No human overall fit scores are assigned.
